uncited: Each `IVec3` represents the integer grid coordinates $(x, y, z)$ of an occupied voxel.
**Rendering:** Iterate through every `IVec3` in the `voxels` hash set.
- Grid Alignment: Voxels are strictly integer-aligned.
- **Performance:** Naively drawing individual cubes for every voxel in the hash set results in poor performance due to high vertex upload overhead.
- **Existence Check:** The structure only tracks existence.
- **Performance:** Naive rendering (one draw call per voxel) scales poorly with voxel count due to CPU-GPU communication overhead.
This structure is presented in the tutorial "Make yourself a Voxel Engine THIS weekend" as a foundational step in building a voxel engine.
